findings.title: Replay with a different amount/currency returns the old receipt instead of rejecting the conflict
findings.evidence: prior = store.begin(idempotency_key) followed by 'if prior is not None:' / 'return prior' — the prior receipt is returned without comparing amount_cents or currency, and begin/complete never store the request parameters.
findings.recommendation: Record the request fingerprint alongside the receipt (e.g. _completed[key] = (amount_cents, currency, receipt)) and, on replay, compare the stored amount/currency with the incoming ones; raise a distinct IdempotencyKeyConflict error (HTTP 409-style) when they differ instead of returning the stale receipt. Scope the key namespace to the caller/account if keys are client-supplied so two callers cannot share receipts.

findings.title: None receipt is indistinguishable from the not-claimed sentinel, allowing a double charge
findings.evidence: begin returns 'return self._completed[key]' for a completed key, but if gateway.charge returned None, complete stored None and the caller's 'if prior is not None:' check treats the key as unclaimed and charges the gateway a second time.
findings.recommendation: Use an explicit sentinel or a tuple/result object (e.g. return a (claimed, receipt) pair, or store a dedicated CompletedReceipt wrapper) so a None/falsy receipt is still recognised as already completed; alternatively reject a None receipt from the gateway in complete().

findings.title: In-flight keys have no lease/timeout, so a hung gateway call blocks that key forever
findings.evidence: 'raise DuplicateRequestInFlight(key)' — a key is only released by complete() or abandon(), so if gateway.charge blocks indefinitely (charge_once passes no timeout) every subsequent retry for that key fails permanently; _completed also grows without bound on a long-lived process.
findings.recommendation: Give in-flight entries a timestamp/lease so stale claims can be reclaimed (and log/metric the reclaim), pass an explicit timeout to gateway.charge so hang windows are bounded, and add an eviction/TTL policy for _completed.

findings.title: No tests exercise the dedupe, concurrent-duplicate, or error-path behaviour
findings.evidence: charge_once and PaymentStore are added with no accompanying test module, and the change context states no test commands were run.

findings.recommendation: Add tests with a fake gateway asserting: single charge for a repeated key, DuplicateRequestInFlight for a concurrent claim (two threads / pre-seeded _in_flight), gateway exception releases the key and propagates, mismatched amount on replay is rejected, and validation errors do not consume the key.
